title: Affordable Homes for Vulnerable Residents
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   Approved a $500,000 loan to acquire eight condominium units on Manchaca Road, designated as permanent supportive housing.
*   These new condos will provide crucial homes for very low-income residents living with disabilities.
*   Authorized a construction contract exceeding $1 million to build up to 12 new single-family homes through the Neighborhood Stabilization Program.
